questions.explanation: 'What a fool' fronting exclaims emphatically.
questions.q: ___ a fool he was to trust them!

questions.explanation: Fronted 'So + adjective' triggers inversion: 'So violent was the storm'.
questions.q: ___ violent was the storm that trees were uprooted.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Such' triggers inversion: 'Such was his anger that...'.
options: Such his anger was that he left.
So was his anger that he left.
Such was his anger that he left.
Such was his anger so that he left.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: Fronted direction adverbials invert: 'Down came the rain'.
questions.q: ___ came the rain, ruining the parade.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'here' inverts with present simple: 'Here comes the bus'.
questions.q: ___ the bus!

questions.explanation: Fronting the object emphasizes it: 'This I must see to believe'.
questions.q: ___ I must see to believe.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Little' (meaning 'not') triggers inversion: 'Little did we expect'.
questions.q: ___ did we expect the news.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'So + adjective' inverts: 'So exhausted was she that...'.
questions.q: ___ exhausted was she that she fell asleep instantly.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'there' inverts: 'There goes my last chance'.
questions.q: ___ my last chance.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Never' triggers inversion: 'Never have I been'.
options: Never I have been so insulted.
Never I had been so insulted.
Never have I been so insulted.
Never have I be so insulted.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Such a' inverts: 'Such a beautiful sight met our eyes'.
questions.q: ___ a beautiful sight met our eyes.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Only then' triggers inversion: 'Only then did she realize'.
questions.q: ___ she realized her mistake.

questions.explanation: Fronted complements invert: 'Proud stood the old castle'.
questions.q: ___ stood the old castle on the hill.

questions.explanation: 'How + adjective' fronts exclamations: 'How happy they were!'.
questions.q: ___ happy they were to see us!

questions.explanation: Fronted 'So + adjective' needs inversion: 'So tired was she that...'.
options: So tired she was that she slept.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'there' inverts: 'There lay the missing keys'.
questions.q: ___ lay the missing keys, under the sofa.

questions.explanation: Fronted past participle inverts: 'Gone are the days...'.
questions.q: ___ are the days of cheap flights.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Not a' triggers inversion: 'Not a sound did we hear'.
questions.q: ___ sound did we hear in the empty house.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Seldom' triggers inversion: 'Seldom have I seen'.
options: Seldom I have seen such courage.
Seldom I had seen such courage.
Seldom have I saw such courage.
Seldom have I seen such courage.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: Fronted 'Off' inverts: 'Off they ran'.
questions.q: ___ they ran when they saw us.
